name: deepseek-web
description: Chat with the DeepSeek web app (chat.deepseek.com). Selectors were read off a real DOM dump from this machine; the session lives in the persistent browser profile, so login happens once, by hand.
notes: Selectors confirmed against a live page on 2026-09-11: the composer is a <textarea>, the assistant answer body is div.ds-assistant-message-main-content. No stop control was found in the captured DOM, so completion is detected by DOM text stability instead of the stop button disappearing; raise stable_polls before lowering completion.timeout_ms. Login, captcha and risk-control flows are never automated (project rule) - sign in manually in the headed window. The page is driven the way a person drives it (mouse movement, per-character typing with a variable rhythm, pauses); no fingerprint or stealth handling is involved. An open conversation is REUSED by default - pass --new-conversation for a fresh thread. 深度思考 (thinking mode) is switched on before each message by the profile's toggles; its ON marker is aria-pressed='true' on div.ds-toggle-button.

toggles.name: 深度思考
toggles.description: DeepSeek's thinking mode. Switched ON before every message: the page keeps whatever the last session left behind, and the agent wants the model's reasoning rather than a quick guess.
